{{Quote|Twenty years ago the Empire executed my father for espionage.''"<br />"''That's one of the risks of this business, isn't it?''"<br />"''Yes, and one I take. But all Bothans are not spies, M. Rendar. My father was a teacher. He was guilty of nothing save trying to educate his students about the Empire.|Koth Melan and Dash Rendar|<ref name="soten" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Koth Melan]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who worked as a [[Teacher/Legends|teacher]]. He disagreed with the philosophy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and attempted to educate his students of the government's nature. He was subsequently arrested by the Empire on false charges of [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] and [[Death/Legends|executed]].<ref name="soten" />
